name: KGStructureMap
title: Knowledge graph L3: Structure Map
description: A FHIR StructureMap. The SOP requires them in threes -- QuestionnaireResponse to logical model, logical model to resource, and a grouping map -- so a count that is not a multiple of three is worth a look. 16 .fml files in the immunizations IG. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/structure-map.

element.definition: A FHIR StructureMap. The SOP requires them in threes -- QuestionnaireResponse to logical model, logical model to resource, and a grouping map -- so a count that is not a multiple of three is worth a look. 16 .fml files in the immunizations IG. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/structure-map.
The canonical URL. Only a resolved component carries one.
The FHIR resource type.
A profile canonical the artefact declares (meta.profile or the requirement's profile).
The resource's status (FHIR PublicationStatus).
The business version, as declared.
The human-readable title.
The computable name: the CamelCase identifier a Canonical() reference matches on.
The publisher, as declared.
The resource's experimental flag.
Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.
Hash of the file the node was read from; pins the source.
